# AutoSpill reference fixtures

These are deterministic synthetic inputs, not biological acquisitions. The
seeded lognormal/noise/outlier cases and a noise-free independent Cartesian
autofluorescence case are generated by `tools/validate_autospill_reference.py`.

`controls.npz` holds acquired arrays, zero-based R-selected cleanup event IDs,
native biexponential lookup tables and independent R spline evaluations.
`truth.json` records initial/final spillover matrices, residual slopes,
convergence histories, the physical input matrices, source/runtime pins and SHA256
hashes. `SHA256SUMS` identifies the exact golden files.

Expected numerical outputs use the author's unmodified R functions from
[carlosproca/autospill, commit 1e60e86337b297f1dd9ffec6701d8010dd06175b](https://github.com/carlosproca/autospill/tree/1e60e86337b297f1dd9ffec6701d8010dd06175b).
Thin adapters replace flowCore object access with matrices and tripack's hull
with R's convex hull. Density, tessellation, robust fitting and refinement use the
original functions, MASS and the referenced R packages.

Transform tables come from original native lookup methods at
[RGLab/cytolib, commit 1f886d99b51c520b7adf19d1cc570bbfdc61c315](https://github.com/RGLab/cytolib/tree/1f886d99b51c520b7adf19d1cc570bbfdc61c315),
compiled in the ignored validation cache. `stats::splinefun(method="natural")`
provides independent spline/extrapolation truth. The production code is not
used to generate these outputs. Validation uses R 4.5.2 and MASS 7.3-65; this
runtime is newer than the paper's and not included in the app.

Author AutoSpill code is MIT licensed; its notice is in
`licenses/AutoSpill-MIT.txt`. The AGPL cytolib reference source/executable and
R runtime remain ignored validation dependencies and are not shipped. The app's
lookup mathematics follows BSD-licensed FlowKit and uses SciPy interpolation.

The `af` and `af_independent` cases intentionally retain coefficient bias under
default trimming despite convergence. A separate physical-truth test verifies
recovery of the independent fixture with trimming disabled. See
`docs/AUTOSPILL.md` for assumptions, differences and interpretation. These
fixtures do not establish FlowJo or biological accuracy.
